name: Observe Terminal Vessel Feature Development
description: Observe development of new features in terminal vessel, capturing before/after state, code changes, and validation results

prompt.template:
Capture baseline state:
1. Run: git status --porcelain > /tmp/terminal-dev-git-before.txt
2. Run: git rev-parse HEAD > /tmp/terminal-dev-commit-before.txt
3. Run: find repos/terminal/src -type f -name '*.ts' | xargs wc -l | tail -1 > /tmp/terminal-dev-loc-before.txt
4. Run: bun test 2>&1 | grep -E '(pass|fail)' | tail -1 > /tmp/terminal-dev-tests-before.txt

Implement feature: {{impulses.feature_description.content}}

Context:
{{impulses.current_codebase}}

Implement the feature following these guidelines:
1. Modify existing files or create new ones as needed
2. Follow TypeScript best practices
3. Add types for all new functions
4. Update tests if functionality changes
5. Run typecheck after changes

Do NOT use LLM for this - just execute the implementation.

Validate implementation:
1. Run: cd repos/terminal && bun run typecheck 2>&1 | tee /tmp/terminal-dev-typecheck.txt
2. Check exit code: echo $? > /tmp/terminal-dev-typecheck-exit.txt
3. Run: bun test 2>&1 | tee /tmp/terminal-dev-test-output.txt
4. Check test exit code: echo $? > /tmp/terminal-dev-test-exit.txt

Capture post-implementation state:
1. Run: git status --porcelain > /tmp/terminal-dev-git-after.txt
2. Run: git diff > /tmp/terminal-dev-diff.txt
3. Run: find repos/terminal/src -type f -name '*.ts' | xargs wc -l | tail -1 > /tmp/terminal-dev-loc-after.txt

Compute changes:
1. Run: diff /tmp/terminal-dev-git-before.txt /tmp/terminal-dev-git-after.txt > /tmp/terminal-dev-git-delta.txt || true
2. Count modified files: wc -l < /tmp/terminal-dev-git-after.txt > /tmp/terminal-dev-files-changed.txt
3. Calculate LOC delta: paste /tmp/terminal-dev-loc-before.txt /tmp/terminal-dev-loc-after.txt | awk '{print $1 - $NF}' > /tmp/terminal-dev-loc-delta.txt

Classify outcome:
1. Read typecheck exit: TYPECHECK_EXIT=$(cat /tmp/terminal-dev-typecheck-exit.txt)
2. Read test exit: TEST_EXIT=$(cat /tmp/terminal-dev-test-exit.txt)
3. If both = 0: echo 'SUCCESS' > /tmp/terminal-dev-outcome.txt
4. If typecheck != 0: echo 'FAILED_TYPECHECK' > /tmp/terminal-dev-outcome.txt
5. If test != 0: echo 'FAILED_TESTS' > /tmp/terminal-dev-outcome.txt
6. Report outcome
